description: Two walled channels of settled flowing water (the source at x = 0, levels 1 to 7 downstream, so about half a block deep midway), one over slime and one over ice: jump off the end wall onto the slime, bounce, walk and jump against the current; then step off onto the ice, walk, sprint, slide and jump.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
